title: A partial last line completed later, then one that never completes
matrix: incomplete JSONL lines and later completion
policy: P6: a line counts once its newline is written. A final line that never gets one (a writer that crashed) is never counted; whether to count a complete JSON object without a newline is a policy question.
derivation: Step 1: A [100, 50] and the first half of B: 150. Step 2: the rest of B [60, 6] and half of C: 216, 2 operations. C is never complete.
